notes.title: Who's the basketball star?
notes.content:
Join our official discord：https://discord.gg/magecosmos-841876916227014656

Attention all basketball fans: We are looking for the star shooter on the court! 
During the Next Fest event, each player can play the basketball machine on Isle Island to get special rewards!

Here are the reward details for each stage:

 Stage 1: Score 100 points in a single game to receive 10 MageStones.
 Stage 2: Score 110 points in a single game to receive 20 MageStones.
 Stage 3: Score 120 points in a single game to receive 30 MageStones.
 Stage 4: Score 130 points in a single game to receive 50 MageStones.

Notes:

 MageStone is an important currency in the game, with it, you can buy more interesting game items, as well as exclusive avatars!
 The rewards will be automatically sent to your email, so please remember to check it.

What are you waiting for? Gather around the basketball machines on Eternal Isle and shoot the perfect shot!

notes.title: Welcome to MageCosmos Party. We are waiting for YOU!
notes.content:
MageCosmos is a new VR social game that focuses on multiplayer entertainment and casual gameplay. It is a perfect choice for fun with friends and family, as well as expanding your social circle! It is now available on Steam, PICO CN, and Meta Quest. We warmly invite you to download and enjoy the game with us. Let's Explore Infinity together!

Official Discord: https://discord.gg/magecosmos-841876916227014656


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559999/b597b8d6f5a4add18dc2452b8443dccdbf3edb90.png

About the Game

 Farming

MageCosmos is a world composed of countless floating islands. Here, you will own three islands as your home, where you can live as a real farmer! Planting crops, raising livestock, stealing others' products, hosting parties... everything will happen as your own wish!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559999/31a1fd56552652a54fd2d27c0d0cb8bf2fdd6239.png

 Social

No adventure is complete without friends! Making friends is the most effortless thing in MageCosmos! Whether you're soaring on a magical broomstick to visit others' islands or serendipitously encountering kindred spirits in the world, opportunities abound! Different-themed worlds and various exhilarating mini-games will enliven the atmosphere for you. From thrilling gunfights and intense sword duels to crazy home defense battles and leisurely flies, there's always a game suited for you and your friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559999/d24f72466910bef8749053fc3712e95fac4ea6e5.png

 Pets

With such expansive islands, why not keep some adorable pets to bring more fun? We have orange cats, huskies, koalas, and penguins. Wait, you're craving something extraordinary? Not to worry! Rare pets like phoenixes and giant dragons eagerly await to be summoned! Just imagine roaming the world with these majestic creatures by your side, trust me, you'll rock the world!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559999/1e120629dc80ff9d6a0e3ad3cacd4536edda3a27.png

MageCosmos has much more to be explored than revealed. However, if we disclosed everything, it would deprive you of the joy of exploring on your own. So, swiftly don your equipment and embark on an adventure to discover the wonders that await!
